title: 有馬記念の後に・情熱を世界に！

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gracias, Divinaaa!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… El…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El… Phew!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the Arima Kinen is over! No one could keep up! No one could catch her!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa has secured a sweeping victory on powerful wings! Today, the world has witnessed the birth of a phoenix!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In this moment, the talents of the world's strongest finally reach their true potential.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! Bueno…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sob!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I… did it… It's not just words anymore. I'm the world's… strong—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush to her side to help her calm down. After giving the race her all, she can't control her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, at the awards ceremony…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And with this, our fierce battle, our final confrontation—it all ends here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We've reached the last big race of the year, and I'm the winnerrr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Also, I wasn't crying. Maybe it looked like it, but I totally wasn't!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I just had dirt in my mask! Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I said, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give in to the pressure. She seems a bit worried about crying in front of the audience.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, now that I won, I'm going abroad, just as promised.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I wanna put the strength that I've honed with Spe and Grass to good use.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But power isn't the only thing I'm bringing to the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Did everyone have a good time today?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Are you fired up?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! This kind of excitement and enthusiasm can't be made with only strength!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This Arima Kinen was born from friends who competed and grew together—friends who support each other, yet don't hold back when it's time to fight…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And alongside the fans who came to watch their saga play out, they created a truly passionate battle!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So now, I'm gonna bring this passion to the whole world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There won't be a single boring race, lap, or even second!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We Umamusume will run and entertain the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A certain wrestler once said, "Power isn't justice—justice is power."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: To which I say this! The world's strongest racer isn't the best in the world…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The best in the world is the world's strongest racer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Grass. Thank you, Spe. Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, I'm gonna work hard with my trainer to take the world by storm and get everyone across it calling my name!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Isn't El amazing, Grass? She's…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass, what's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Nothing. I just…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm going to miss her is all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: El! El! El!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The endless calls of the crowd echo through the air as the sun sets on Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only did El Condor Pasa win, but she put on an incredible race for all of her fans.
